coverageRationale.zh: 把 GB/T 39786-2021 的四级密码应用要求、30 项技术指标 +19 项管理指标、等级强度与模块等级写成可复述判定矩阵；明确第五级只给通用要求，附录 B 给密钥生存周期 10 环节。
coverageRationale.en: Rewrites GB/T 39786-2021 as a reproducible decision matrix: four levels of cryptography application requirements, 30 technical + 19 management indicators, strength grades and module levels; level 5 is general-only, and Annex B gives a ten-stage key life cycle.

zh.principle: **标准**：信息系统密码应用基本要求（Basic Requirements for Cryptography Application in Information Systems）。GB/T 39786-2021 把信息系统的密码应用要求写成一张四级矩阵。第一至第四级同时给技术与管理要求；第五级只写“略”，不给技术/管理条款。技术 4 层是物理和环境、网络和通信、设备和计算、应用和数据；管理 4 维是制度、人员、建设运行、应急。数行：技术 30 行 = 物理 5 + 网络 7 + 设备 8 + 应用数据 10；管理 19 行 = 制度 6 + 人员 5 + 建设运行 5 + 应急 3；合计 49 行。每行在四级上取“—/可/宜/应”，强度递增；“可”是可选，“宜”是推荐，“应”是必须。密码模块等级随系统等级：L2 起要求 GB/T 37092 一级及以上，L3 二级及以上，L4 三级及以上；L1 的产品行是“—”。因此系统等级、技术/管理行、模块等级是三张不同的表，不能互相替代。判定式：Conform(S,k)=∀i R(i,k) 满足 ∧ P_k 满足。它表达的是“该系统在第 k 级是否同时满足所有适用行与模块等级”，不是“得了多少分”。
zh.why: 这是“基线”而不是“测评方法”。它告诉你第一至第四级各应做什么，不告诉你测评机构如何抽样、评分、判不符合；测评还要看配套测评标准与密码产品认证。为什么是 49 行而不是 30 行：技术 30 行是四个层面里的具体控制点，管理 19 行是制度/人员/建设运行/应急的组织控制；只看技术会漏掉密钥管理、人员岗位与应急。为什么第五级单列：标准只给通用要求，技术/管理条款“略”；把第五级当成“L4 再加几条”会误读。为什么模块等级单独写：系统 L3 要求模块 L2+，不是“系统三级=模块三级”；模块等级是产品认证的安全保障级别，系统等级是业务/数据保护级别。
zh.used: 落地顺序：1) 按业务/数据定系统等级；2) 取该级 49 行中适用的技术要求与管理要求；3) 把每行落到密码服务/产品/流程；4) 按系统等级选模块等级；5) 按附录 B 管密钥 10 环节；6) 留制度、记录、评估与应急证据。典型映射：L1 只做最低技术 + 基础制度/密钥规则；L2 加操作规程、岗位责任、培训、预案；L3 加真实性/机密性、制度修订/发布/记录、评估与演练；L4 再加完整性/不可否认性。密钥 10 环节是产生、分发、存储、使用、更新、归档、撤销、备份、恢复、销毁；归档密钥只能解密/验证历史数据，销毁必须不可逆。
zh.broken: “可”不是“建议采用”：在基线语境它是可选；但系统定级后，评估按该级取值判定，不会因为“可”就自动算通过。标准不替代测评结论、不替代 GB/T 37092 产品认证、不替代密钥生命周期审计；它也不保证具体密码算法/产品安全。第五级没有技术/管理条款，不能拿 L4 条款倒推 L5。常见错误：只看技术 30 行，漏管理 19 行；把模块等级等同系统等级；把“应”写成“宜”；把附录 B 的资料性建议当强制条款；把 49 行当得分表。
zh.history:
2018 年国家密码管理局发布 GM/T 0054-2018《信息系统密码应用基本要求》，作为行业标准先行；GB/T 39786-2021 在此基础上修改完善并上升为国家标准，2021-03-09 发布、2021-10-01 实施，24 页，现行。官方发布公告明确它是商用密码应用与安全性评估的基础性标准；该条目按 2021 版写，不把后续测评标准或地方细则混入。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：信息系统密码应用基本要求的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 信息系统密码应用基本要求 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

en.principle: **Standard**: Basic Requirements for Cryptography Application in Information Systems (信息系统密码应用基本要求). GB/T 39786-2021 writes information-system cryptography requirements as a four-level matrix. Levels 1 to 4 give both technical and management requirements; level 5 says only “omitted” and gives no technical/management clauses. The four technical layers are physical/environment, network/communication, device/computing, and application/data; the four management dimensions are policy, personnel, construction/operation and emergency response. The row count: technical 30 = physical 5 + network 7 + device 8 + application/data 10; management 19 = policy 6 + personnel 5 + construction/operation 5 + emergency 3; 49 rows total. Each row takes —/可/宜/应 across the four levels, in increasing strength; “可” is optional, “宜” recommended and “应” mandatory. The cryptographic-module level follows the system level: from L2 the module must be GB/T 37092 level 1+, L3 level 2+, L4 level 3+; the L1 product row is “—”. System level, technical/management rows and module level are therefore three different tables and cannot replace one another. The decision formula is Conform(S,k)=∀i R(i,k) satisfied ∧ P_k satisfied. It says whether the system at level k satisfies all applicable rows and the module level simultaneously; it is not a score.
en.why:
This is a baseline, not an assessment method. It states what levels 1-4 should do, not how an assessor samples, scores or records nonconformity; assessment also depends on the companion assessment standard and cryptographic-product certification.

Why 49 rows rather than 30: the 30 technical rows are specific control points in four layers, while the 19 management rows are organisational controls for policy, personnel, construction/operation and emergency response; looking only at technology misses key management, job roles and response.

Why level 5 is separate: the standard gives only general requirements and says the technical/management clauses are “omitted”; treating level 5 as “level 4 plus a few rows” misreads it.

Why module level is separate: a level-3 system requires a level-2+ module, not “system level 3 = module level 3”; module level is the assurance level of a certified product, system level is the business/data protection level.
en.used:
Deployment order: 1) determine the system level from business/data; 2) take the applicable technical and management rows of that level from the 49; 3) map each row to a cryptographic service, product or process; 4) choose the module level for the system level; 5) manage the ten key-life-cycle stages per Annex B; 6) keep evidence of policy, records, assessment and emergency response.

A typical mapping: L1 has minimum technical measures plus basic policy/key rules; L2 adds operating procedures, job responsibility, training and response plans; L3 adds authenticity/confidentiality, policy revision/release/records, assessment and drills; L4 adds integrity/non-repudiation.

The ten key stages are generation, distribution, storage, use, update, archive, revocation, backup, recovery and destruction; an archived key only decrypts/verifies historical data, and destruction must be irreversible.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
“可” does not mean “recommended”: in this baseline it is optional; but once the system level is set, assessment judges the value at that level and does not pass a row merely because it says “可”.

The standard does not replace an assessment verdict, GB/T 37092 product certification or a key-life-cycle audit, and it does not guarantee a particular algorithm or product. Level 5 has no technical/management clauses; do not infer it from L4.

Common errors: reading only the 30 technical rows and missing the 19 management rows; equating module level with system level; writing “应” as “宜”; treating Annex B’s informative advice as mandatory; treating the 49 rows as a score sheet.
en.history:
In 2018 the State Cryptography Administration issued GM/T 0054-2018, “Baseline requirements for information system cryptography application”, as an industry standard; GB/T 39786-2021 revised and elevated it to a national standard, published on 2021-03-09, effective 2021-10-01, 24 pages and current.

The official release notice calls it a foundational standard for commercial cryptography application and security assessment; this card follows the 2021 edition and does not mix in later assessment standards or local rules.
